Reflecting on the highs and lows of his Argentina career, she wrote: 'I saw you keep going when things didn't work out and always try again.' Roccuzzo said she felt lucky to watch Messi 'fulfill your dreams' and added: 'You deserved this story and so much more. We love you infinitely.'
